narrative: CES40-2414B-0337 threw a DC ground fault alarm so I went out and isolated it down to CB-B04-24 where there was a home run chafed clean through against the rack upright, the insulation was worn right down to the conductor on it. Repaired the run and got it resecured properly clear of the steel with a standoff rather than just a tie the way it was. Unit is back in service and the fault has not come back. That is the second one like it on that block and I would say it is worth somebody walking the rest of the runs there.
